subject: Decision sufficiency under partial observability and Authority-Mirror-Witness specialization
reason: The new mathematical recovery criterion ker(Obs') subset ker(C), its Lean formalization, and the Authority-Mirror-Witness specialization do not change the Effect-Acknowledgement wire format, protocol state machine, DONE predicate, security requirements, transport semantics, or interoperability behavior. They refine the mathematical justification of decision sufficiency only.
